title: Gopal Gautam v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Krishna Murari, J.; Vijay Lakshmi, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; liberty to apply under Supply Code 2005
headnote: A writ complaining of non-grant of an electricity connection, unsupported by any document of a proper application, is disposed of with liberty to apply under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005; such an application is to be decided expeditiously in accordance with law.
facts: Gopal Gautam approached the Allahabad High Court in a writ petition against the State of Uttar Pradesh and two other respondents, complaining that he was not being provided an electricity connection despite having applied. Counsel for respondent nos. 2 and 3 accepted notice. The Court found that the petitioner had not placed on record any document showing that a proper application had ever been made.

holding_units.holding: Where the petitioner has not shown a proper application on record, the writ is disposed of with liberty to make a proper application for an electricity connection under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, to be disposed of expeditiously in accordance with law.
holding_units.flag: order invokes Supply Code 2005 generally; no clause numbered

not_decided.point: Whether the petitioner had made a proper application or was entitled to a new electricity connection
